_comment: Every item that fails any gate lands here with the reason, timestamp, and which gate failed. Never silently discarded or forced through. Reviewed periodically to spot systemic issues (e.g. a gate that's too strict, or a recurring source problem).

short_form.gate: basic_qa (quality risk, Agent 0 judgement call — no literal gates.json rule directly covers this case)
short_form.reason: Produced file (assets/short-form-clips/processed/sf_001.mp4, 1080x1920, 29s, verified via ffprobe) correctly applied the short_form_gates.copyright_gate mitigation checklist in full (vertical reframe, 0.90x speed change + color grade, 5 burned-in on-screen-text beats, original audio fully replaced with a verified CC0 track). However, the script's voiceover_script (full narrated spoken-word lines that are the core creative device of this candidate's angle) was never added — no TTS engine is available in this environment, so Agent 3.1's own mandatory checklist step 6 (voiceover) was left incomplete by necessity, not oversight. Publishing a spoken-word-monologue concept with zero spoken words as the channel's first-ever video is a quality/creative-intent mismatch significant enough to withhold rather than auto-publish under a gate that doesn't explicitly anticipate this case. Holding for a human decision: accept text-only shorts as the format going forward, or add a TTS step to the pipeline before this candidate (or others like it) can publish.
short_form.additional_note: Visual clip selection (56.mp4, 50.mp4, 39.mp4, looped ABCABC to reach 29s) was also only a weak heuristic (file size as a low-motion proxy) since no video-viewing capability exists to genuinely match visual_direction; flagged for awareness, not treated as a separate gate failure.
short_form.cc0_track_used: Phonk ish by HoliznaCC0 (CC0 1.0, verified) — this part of the pipeline worked correctly and the track is retained in state/cc0_audio_library.json for reuse.

short_form.gate: short_form_gates.copyright_gate visual-match spirit / basic_qa (quality risk, Agent 0 judgement call — no literal gates.json rule directly covers this case)
short_form.reason: Script and audio were fine (produced, 1080x1920, 26s, 13 shots at exactly 2.00s each, verified via ffprobe and a full-decode null pass — meets the new hard 2s-per-shot cap correctly). But the visual content is a real mismatch: Agent 3.1's file-size heuristic picked clips 28/35/27/45/16/19/47/2, which turned out to be mountain biking, a red Lamborghini, a floating luxury breakfast tray, and a cruise ship — nothing resembling the script's 'dark academia library/candlelit desk/reading alone' concept. Agent 0 visually inspected the produced video's frames directly (real image review, not just trusting the transform_log) and confirmed the mismatch is severe, not a minor approximation.
short_form.root_cause: Agent 0 then reviewed a contact sheet of all 49 available raw clips directly: the entire raw clip pool (assets/short-form-clips/raw/, sourced from a 'luxury lifestyle' Pinterest collection per its README) contains ZERO literal library/book/candlelight/academic footage — only supercars, yachts, jetskis, money, hot air balloons, and travel/skyline shots. This isn't a clip-selection bug to fix with a better heuristic; the source material genuinely cannot represent this angle's visual concept. File-size (or any other blind heuristic over this pool) will keep picking mismatched luxury/car content for any non-luxury-lifestyle angle.
short_form.recommendation: Two options: (1) source new raw footage that actually matches 'dark academia' visual angles (library interiors, candlelight, rain-on-window, turning book pages) before scripting this angle again, or (2) have Agent 1.1 (Trend Scout) weight future short-form angles toward concepts the existing luxury-lifestyle clip pool can actually support (wealth/cars/travel/luxury-adjacent mindset angles), reserving 'reading/library/academic' angles until matching footage exists. Did not delete or force-publish sf_003 — kept produced file and full script/transform_log in state/short_form_queue.json for reuse if footage is sourced later.
short_form.cc0_track_used: Phonk ish by HoliznaCC0 (CC0 1.0, verified, reused correctly) — audio sourcing/pacing/text-sizing all worked correctly this cycle; only the visual content selection failed.

short_form.gate: short_form_gates.copyright_gate visual-match spirit (same root cause as sf_001/sf_003, pre-emptive quarantine before production)
short_form.reason: Angle is 'Built different' gym-mindset progress narrative — quick-cut visual of grinding through a hard set. Per assets/short-form-clips/raw/README.md's Content scope note, the raw clip pool is 100% luxury-lifestyle (cars, yachts, jets, cash, travel, skylines) with zero gym/workout footage, the same root cause that got sf_001 quarantined. Quarantining pre-emptively rather than repeating the sf_001/sf_003 pattern of producing first and discovering the mismatch after.
short_form.recommendation: Same as sf_003: either source real gym/workout footage before scripting this angle again, or let it stay quarantined until Agent 1.1 scouts a fitting replacement (as it did for sf_003 -> sf_005, sf_006, sf_007).
